findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 風險因素：供應鏈受供應商產能、制裁與貿易限制、關稅及地緣事件影響，點名俄烏戰爭與中美台關係
findings.excerpt: Our supply chain has been and may continue to be impacted by a wide variety of factors, including supplier capacity constraints, sanctions and trade restrictions and other governmental regulatory actions or inactions, labor and material shortages as well as tariffs and other geopolitical events, such as the Russia-Ukraine war and China's relationship with the United States and Taiwan.

findings.claim: FY2023 10-K：部分零組件有唯一供應商，若延遲或無法供貨可能無法及時生產
findings.excerpt: If a sole-source supplier is delayed or should cease or otherwise be unable to deliver such components, we may not be able to produce the related product in a timely manner or in sufficient quantities, if at all, which could adversely affect our operating results.

findings.claim: Q2 2026 法說：上半年供應鏈壓力上升，特別是表面處理用稀土材料與化合物
findings.excerpt: supply chain pressures have increased in the first half of this year, especially for rare earth materials and compounds used in surface treatment.

findings.claim: Q1 2026 法說：供應鏈關注記憶體與儲存晶片、PCB、稀土礦物，並與客戶及供應商合作認證替代來源
findings.excerpt: the company is focused on memory and storage chips, printed circuit board-related issues and rare earth minerals.
